interpretation.directEvidence: Both models first follow the same wrong-path rodata decode redirect. Old builds two synchronous Generic page table fault carriers at tick360896000, sends both immediately, Decode sees both at360899000. Candidate records two request faults but builds one demanded-byte carrier at360897000, which Decode sees at360900000. In both, the older actual jalr atPC10708/sn2160537 squashes this entire wrong path; Fetch recovers at360903000.
interpretation.bubbleAccounting: One fewer supplied carrier adds one unused slot; the observed decodeStalls decrease by1 allows one additional six-slot cycle to be counted. This matches fetchBubbles+7/fetchBubbles_max+1 under fetch.cc measureFrontendBubbles; nine IEW slot counters propagate stall-reason vectors through Decode/Rename. These explanations do not waive strict comparison.
